town_description: Takhtupura is a village in Nihal Singhwala tehsil of Moga district, Punjab, about 32 km southeast of Moga city. Its Nanaksar Sahib complex of three shrines commemorates the visits of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, Guru Hargobind Ji and Guru Gobind Singh Ji.
